headlines: SPY 717.81 (-1.70%) at 12:06 ET, sitting on its day low 717.78 after opening 737.46 and peaking 739.89: a full failed-gap reversal (Stocktwits)
AMD -9.3% at 480.5 (high 555, low 470.69); AMD statement relayed on Stocktwits says Hunterbrook claims misrepresent its practices and it complies with US export control laws
Semis/AI names weak: NBIS -7.3%, AMD -9.3%; QQQ had been +0.71% on the 16:09Z delayed Stocklake snapshot, now likely negative
Anthropic (ANT) #1 trending: opened 112.97 vs 83 IPO price, high 115, now 98.76 (+19% vs IPO, fading from open)
Stocklake pulse 16:09Z: VIX 24.36 (up from 22.61 last hour), Fear & Greed 23.9 extreme fear; breadth 8.1% oversold vs 2.9% overbought; GLD -1.09%, IWM -0.63%
Web: S&P 500 had its worst day in over a year on Nov 17 led by Nvidia/AI stocks; Nasdaq recently in correction territory
Calendar: no US releases today; Japan CPI 23:30Z; UK and Canada retail sales tomorrow

rumors.text: Hunterbrook short report alleges AMD practices tied to export controls; AMD says the claims misrepresent its practices
rumors.why: An export-control probe on a megacap AI chip name would keep pressure on semis, QQQ and SPY; a firm denial could spark a rebound

rumors.text: Wall Street is dumping AI winners to fund allocations to the Anthropic IPO
rumors.why: If funds are rotating out of AI megacaps, selling could persist until IPO demand settles

rumors.text: NVIDIA spent about $10bn of company resources buying into Anthropic
rumors.why: Bears frame it as circular AI financing at a rich valuation; would feed AI-bubble worries

rumors.text: Market is pricing a major recession despite strong earnings
rumors.why: Pure opinion; no US data today supports it (last hour's weak-data claim was not on the calendar)

rumors.text: UNH falling a third straight day on the same news, now about -6.8% today
rumors.why: Managed-care selling weighs on health care and the Dow

plays.reason: Full failed-gap reversal now pinned at the day low with semis breaking down; trend days often close near lows, but extreme fear and oversold breadth limit edge
plays.catalyst: AMD/Hunterbrook semis selling, ANT IPO fading from open, VIX rising

readings.whats_new: The bounce failed: SPY fell from 729.61 to 717.81 (-1.70%), a new day low, as AMD extended to -9% and AMD publicly disputed Hunterbrook's export-control claims. VIX rose to 24.36 and Fear & Greed slipped to 24 (extreme fear); ANT's IPO is fading from its 112.97 open to about 98.76.
